messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Elevated 5xx across control-plane dependencies (auth / org-lookup / billing). Spike detected ~05:12 UTC. Error rate ~18% on control-plane routes. Paging on-call: anya. Pagerduty escalation triggered.
anya (oncall): i'm on it — thanks. paging in progress. any immediate customer impact numbers?
mike: seeing a lot of 502/504 from gateway -> auth-service. traces show timeouts on auth token refresh calls: `auth: upstream timeout after 2s`.
leo: org-lookup DB connections at 95% — looks saturated. lots of cache misses. could be a stampede after the TTL change last deploy.
sara: confirmed — there was a config rollout at 04:50 that lowered org-cache TTL from 300s -> 30s. i'm going to revert the TTL now.
anya (oncall): ok, rolling back config flag `org_cache.ttl` -> 300s. doing a canary rollback to us-east-1 first. will update when done.
devops-bot: rollback job queued: cfg-7723. triggered config rollback workflow. tracking: https://console.internal/jobs/cfg-7723
mike: billing token-service also returning 500s under load (token refresh path). clients see 5xx. might need a temporary circuit-breaker or rate-limiter on token refresh endpoints.
leo: i'm scaling org-lookup: bumping HPA to min 4 -> 8 replicas and adding an extra read replica on the DB. applying now.
anya (oncall): enabling gateway fallback: if org-lookup fails, respond with minimal cached payload (org_id only) to avoid full 5xx. patching gateway route.
sara: patch applied to gateway fallback. sample logic:
```
if org_lookup_error -> return {org_id: cached, fallback: true}
```
anya (oncall): also diverting ~30% control-plane traffic to standby-region for quick offload while we stabilize.
rohit: putting auth-service into degraded mode: disable token-introspection-heavy path and skip non-essential lookups. deploying degraded image (tag: auth-deg-2026-03).
mike: auth nodes cpu + tail latency improving after degraded mode. error rate dropped to ~6% (from 18%).
incident-bot: customer-impact summary: 17 of ~80 hosted customers reported elevated 5xx during the 15m window. No data-loss reported. SLA exposure: elevated error/latency — ops team notified.
anya (oncall): handing off to @rohit for next 30m window at 06:15 UTC. rohit please ack and continue debugging.
rohit: ack — taking over. will keep the mitigations in place and collect deeper traces. opening incident ticket and adding runbook steps.
sara: created ticket INC-2026-481: "auth/org-lookup cache refresh surge" assigned to eng-runtime + eng-ml (for traffic pattern analysis). logs archived to s3://redwood-incidents/3777770000/
mike: long-term actions documented: 1) require cache warming on config deploys 2) bump sensible default TTLs 3) add jitter to refreshes to avoid thundering herds 4) implement token-refresh rate-limiting + graceful 503 fallback.
leo: also recommend adding a short circuit-breaker in the gateway to return controlled 503s instead of cascading 5xx when deps are overloaded.
anya (oncall): monitoring: error rate trending down to 2.1% as of 06:10 UTC. keeping mitigations (rollback + degraded mode + routing) for 15m observation window.
rohit: adding runbook steps to incident page and will collect prometheus graphs + flame traces. planning RCA meeting after stabilization.
incident-bot: mitigation status: partial success. system in watch mode. pager state -> watching.
anya (oncall): handoff complete. if error rate >4% reopen paging. big thanks all for fast response :heart:
